INSURANCE

GGS Product Liability Insurance Requirement

IGCL feels proud to be a part of the Product Liability Wrap-Up Program. IGCL extends it full suport and consent to contribute 1% of the Billed Products cost towards its's share for the Premium Charges. The 1% contribution of IGCL to PLI Wrap-Up will be charged by IGCL by incorporating the same in the agreed prices.
